takeaways: Single 3.5" full-range, sealed, 6x4x5 in desktop speaker, 8 Ω nominal (min 6.5 Ω claimed)
ASR Klippel: LW ±3.9 dB, f3 143 Hz, four strong resonances, sens 80.6 vs 88 claimed
Distortion set in before 86 dB SPL; tested at 80/83 dB instead
ASR pref -0.5 / 3.6 with sub; not recommended
Older critic reviews (Bound for Sound via maker, EtM 2006) praise midrange and imaging near-field
conflicts: Critics describe linear response vs ASR four resonances
